name: Ring of Climbing (improved)
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Aura faint transmutation CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 10,000 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring functions as a ring of climbing, except it grants a +10 competence bonus on its wearer’s Climb checks.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, creator must have 10 ranks in the Climb skill; Cost 5,000 gp
